caption: The drawing depicts a quilt composed of a grid of 7 rows by 7 columns, each square containing a unique design. The border of the quilt features a repeating green leaf or branch motif. Within the squares, there are various objects including flowers, birds, geometric shapes, stars, trees, baskets, hearts, animals (such as horses and deer), a house, musical instruments, and a cup. The central square contains the year "1859" inside a circular vignette surrounded by leaves, and the square above the center depicts a large, red and blue house. The designs primarily use red, green, yellow, pink, and blue tones, with the base of the quilt being a cream or off-white background. Some squares also contain text, including "Eagleton" and a signature at the bottom right of the page ("Susanne Roy"). The overall composition is symmetrical and each square is bordered by small green leaf motifs connecting the designs in a network throughout the grid.
title: Applique Quilt
